currency_conversion.conversion_note: Alibaba Cloud publishes Qwen/DashScope token rates in CNY per 1M tokens. USD estimates use 1 CNY = 0.148 USD, observed during the 2026-06-05 implementation pass.

notes: Native Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / DashScope OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions rates. The pricing helper currently supports one input, cached-input, and output price per exact model. Qwen has region, tier, batch, and context-cache variants; these entries use the documented Global deployment first-tier realtime rates unless the model has a single tier. Cached input is conservatively priced at the same rate as regular input until MakerBench supports Qwen's explicit/implicit cache discount tiers. Qwen reports reasoning tokens as completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens; official output pricing covers thinking chain plus answer, so reasoning tokens are tracked separately for provenance and not billed again.

qwen3.7-max.notes: Current Qwen3.7 Max stable model, documented as equivalent to qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20. Global deployment, 0<Token<=1M first/single tier, thinking and non-thinking modes share the same output price bucket.

qwen3.7-max-2026-05-20.notes: Pinned Qwen3.7 Max snapshot. Keep separate from the stable alias when publishing rows.

qwen3-max.notes: Qwen3 Max stable alias, documented as equivalent to qwen3-max-2026-01-23. Global deployment first tier, 0<Token<=32K; higher prompt-token tiers are not represented by the flat pricing helper.

qwen3-max-2026-01-23.notes: Pinned Qwen3 Max snapshot. Keep separate from qwen3.7-max and from the qwen3-max stable alias when publishing rows.

qwen3-coder-plus.notes: Qwen3 Coder Plus stable alias, documented as equivalent to qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23. Global deployment first tier, 0<Token<=32K; higher tiers and Qwen's cache discounts are not represented by the flat pricing helper.

qwen3-coder-plus-2025-09-23.notes: Pinned Qwen3 Coder Plus snapshot. Keep separate from Max and open-weight Qwen rows.

qwen3-coder-flash.notes: Qwen3 Coder Flash stable alias, documented as equivalent to qwen3-coder-flash-2025-07-28. Global deployment first tier, 0<Token<=32K.

qwen3.6-35b-a3b.notes: Open-weight Qwen3.6 35B A3B served by DashScope Global deployment, 0<Token<=256K tier. Keep open-weight hosted rows distinct from proprietary Max/Coder rows and from local runtime rows.
